```yaml
name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: [1.20, 1.21, 1.22]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Go ${{ matrix.go-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-go@v3
      with:
        go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        go get gopkg.in/stretchr/testify.v1/assert

    - name: Run tests
      run: go test -v ./...
```

yaml:
name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: [1.20, 1.21, 1.22]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Go ${{ matrix.go-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-go@v3
      with:
        go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        go get gopkg.in/stretchr/testify.v1/assert

    - name: Run tests
      run: go test -v ./...
